notes.title: SUFFER 1.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
SUFFER 1.5 Patch Notes


 Implemented Steam Cloud Save Support!
 Implemented 3D audio
 Updated to use more polished sprites from SUFFER 2
 Fix long standing bug with music engine 
 Added missing 'Anarchy' to Challenge Level 2 (Thanks Roman for pointing that out!)

notes.title: SUFFER 2 Release Date 1/13/2023
notes.notes:
Hello Friends!

I'm very happy to announce that SUFFER 2 will be released on Friday the 13th! 

[previewyoutube=9idhm09gHvk;full][/previewyoutube]

January 13th, 2023 you will be able to purchase your copy of SUFFER 2 on Steam! I've been working really hard on this one - it has many improvements over the original game. SUFFER 2 has more weapons, more enemies, better AI, better graphics and effects, an entirely new soundtrack, and it is just a way more polished product. 

I can't wait for players to get their hands on this!

Thank you for everything!

notes.title: SUFFER 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-VDo2PLDiJNk/XapabH4wYXI/AAAAAAAACHY/Qg0fFgcnsVwumC8V0g9kcMrgHblAy26CgCLcBGAsYHQ/s400/suffer1.gif

Hey friends,

I'm happy to announce that SUFFER patch 1.4 is officially live! This update is a "thank you" note to all of you wonderful people who've supported me and my game. I've added in a trio of challenge levels for those who want to come back to SUFFER some more! The patch contains the following:

Challenge Mode - 3 all-new levels for the diehard 4 more Steam AchievementsVarious Performance fixesRiot Police sprite is brighter / easier to seeFixed Demon Lord hurt animation

Thank you!

notes.title: SUFFER 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-AwnXtxnL900/XWCr78WxFKI/AAAAAAAACGs/PC_WmBSOC0I41xzb1kVvn9G0NtGFsR9rACLcBGAs/s640/suffer3.gif
I'm proud to announce that SUFFER has been patched to version 1.3! This is a pretty large update, adding performance improvements, new features, and graphical updates!


Two all-new difficulty modes: Casual and BrutalThree additional achievementsBrand new hidden weapon - the Plasma Hand Cannon!Graphic updates / animation improvementsAdditional scene decalsGameplay balance tweaks (Hitscanner enemies have reduced accuracy, by popular demand!)Performance improvementsBug fixesThis is a very substantial update, I hope you will enjoy it! Thank you for playing my game! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/950210/SUFFER/

notes.title: SUFFER 1.18 patch
notes.notes:
https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-U6XkFne68Ck/XCajXsUlFCI/AAAAAAAAB_s/2l3NOK1rtFUHsx1A_ZeqtaSmrGpvNeaYgCLcBGAs/s1600/suffer%2B%25288%2529.gif
The SUFFER 1.18 patch is out now on Steam! This is the final visual enhancement patch, and SUFFER looks better than ever! The real-time lighting, scene lighting, sprites, and particle effects have all been polished, and several bugs have been fixed.

Fix sentinel "floating corpse" glitch Projectile spawns have improved effects Blood particle effects overhauled Police Commando weapon sound effect updated Scene baked lighting tweaks Muzzle flash real time lighting tweaks Grab your copy of SUFFER today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/950210/SUFFER/

Thank you!

notes.title: SUFFER 1.17 Patch Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey friends!

SUFFER has been patched to version 1.17 today. This update fixes a few bugs, but it is mostly a graphical update.

Updates to scene lighting Updates to real-time lighting effectsSprites have been touched up Fixed a menu bug Fixed controller weapon switch bug Fixed rocket launcher bugPerformance enhancementsThis update makes the game much more enjoyable, and I am very happy with how the game looks and runs! Thank you to everyone for your feedback, SUFFER is now better than ever because of you!

notes.title: SUFFER 1.14 Patch Out Now!
notes.notes:
SUFFER has been updated to version 1.14, which addresses the following:

Update base Unity3d engine to 2018.3.0f2Frame rate and stability improvementsRendering improvementsScene lighting enhancedEnemy projectiles/muzzle flash lighting enhancedGameplay balancingThis is a fairly substantial patch, so I hope it will vastly improve your experience with SUFFER!

notes.title: SUFFER patch v1.11
notes.notes:
Hey friends,

The latest SUFFER patch has gone live today.

SUFFER v1.11 addresses the following issues:

Graphical enhancements, lighting and rendering tweaks
Gameplay balancing updates
Improved keybinding functionality
Fixed bug where users could get stuck in menus
Fixed a bug in the Chapter 4 Boss fight
Fixed music looping bug

This is a pretty substantial patch, and I hope it greatly increases your enjoyment of SUFFER! Don't forget to grab your copy while it's on sale for launch week!
